"""Alert when a pallet stack reaches above the owner's yellow line on the rack."""

import math

LINE = "yellow"
CONCEPT = "pallet"
MARGIN_PX = 0


def line_y_at(line, x):
    x1 = line[0][0]
    y1 = line[0][1]
    x2 = line[1][0]
    y2 = line[1][1]
    if x2 == x1:
        return min(y1, y2)
    return y1 + (y2 - y1) * (x - x1) / (x2 - x1)


def check(sample):
    line = sample.get("lines", {}).get(LINE)
    if not line:
        return {"value": False, "measure": None, "why": "no yellow line drawn"}
    highest = None
    for obj in sample.get("objects", []):
        if CONCEPT not in str(obj.get("concept", "")).lower():
            continue
        box = obj.get("box_xyxy_px")
        top = obj.get("mask_top_y_px")
        if not box or top is None:
            continue
        above_px = line_y_at(line, (box[0] + box[2]) / 2) - top
        if highest is None or above_px > highest:
            highest = above_px
    if highest is None:
        return {"value": False, "measure": None, "why": "no pallet in view"}
    if not math.isfinite(highest):
        return {"value": False, "measure": None, "why": "bad geometry"}
    over = highest > MARGIN_PX
    word = "above" if over else "below"
    return {
        "value": over,
        "measure": round(highest, 1),
        "why": f"pallet top {abs(highest):.0f} px {word} the yellow line",
    }
